title: 0/1 Knapsack
statement:
You are given `n` items each with a weight `w[i]` and a value `v[i]`, and a knapsack with capacity `W`.
Each item can either be taken or not taken (0/1). Return the maximum total value that can be put in the knapsack without exceeding its weight capacity.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers N and W.
Line 2: N space-separated integers for weights.
Line 3: N space-separated integers for values.

starterCode.python:
